target: उन्होंने इस विषय पर एक अच्छी किताब लिखी है।
english: He has written a good book on this subject.
reason: Literary trivia (Tulsidas wrote Ramcharitmanas) that a learner will never say; replacement keeps the same Sanskrit/Persian vocabulary mix and the ergative ने + feminine agreement.

target: इस किताब में बहुत काम की जानकारी है।
english: This book has a lot of useful information.
reason: Flowery motto ('a treasure of knowledge'); replacement says the same thing the way a person actually would.

target: तुम अपने दोस्तों के साथ चले जाओ, मैं बाद में आ जाऊँगा।
english: You go with your friends, I will come later.
reason: Civics trivia list of the armed forces, and it does not show the तुम/आप register contrast this node teaches; replacement is ordinary तुम-register speech.

target: आप यहाँ बैठिए, मैं अभी आपके लिए चाय लाता हूँ।
english: Please sit here, I will bring you tea right away.
reason: Niche puppeteer scene with no register content; replacement teaches the polite आप imperative the node is about.

target: मोमबत्ती की हल्की रोशनी में बैठकर हमने खाना खाया।
english: Sitting in the dim candlelight, we ate our meal.
reason: Rare rural vocabulary (ढिबरी, मद्धम) in a subjectless fragment; replacement keeps the participial clause with everyday words.

target: बच्चों का देर रात तक फ़ोन चलाना चिंता की बात है।
english: Children using their phones late at night is a matter of concern.
reason: School-essay filler about the ozone layer; replacement keeps the nominalized subject construction with a topic people actually discuss.

target: अच्छा खाना बनाना भी एक कला माना जाता है।
english: Cooking well is also considered an art.
reason: Niche content plus a gender-agreement error (लाठी चलाना ... मानी जाती है); replacement fixes the agreement and uses an everyday subject.

target: मंदिर के बाहर जूते उतारकर रखे जाते हैं।
english: Shoes are taken off and kept outside the temple.
reason: Encyclopedic entry about angavastram; replacement keeps the passive plus participial structure with a custom a learner will actually need.

target: मेहमानों को पहले ठंडा पानी दिया जाता है।
english: Guests are given cold water first.
reason: Stilted translationese ('sherbet is distributed to guests'); replacement keeps the impersonal passive in natural phrasing.

target: मरम्मत के काम की वजह से कल दिन भर बिजली नहीं रहेगी।
english: Because of repair work, there will be no electricity all day tomorrow.
reason: Dense bureaucratic notice, and स्थगित is the wrong collocation for power supply (notices use बाधित); replacement keeps the causal clause in speakable Hindi.

target: इन दोनों तरीक़ों में क्या फ़र्क़ है, ज़रा समझा दीजिए।
english: Please explain what the difference between these two methods is.
reason: Abstract motto whose English gloss does not even match the Hindi (नियम is 'rule', not 'theory'); replacement keeps फ़र्क़ in a request a learner would really make.

target: चूँकि आज छुट्टी है, इसलिए बाज़ार की सारी दुकानें बंद हैं।
english: Since today is a holiday, all the shops in the market are closed.
reason: Civics-textbook line about the constitution with no connector, while this node teaches चूँकि/इसलिए; replacement restores the connector pair in an everyday context.

target: बड़े परिवार में रहने से बच्चों को खेलने के लिए साथी मिल जाते हैं।
english: Living in a big family, children get playmates.
reason: Moralising motto about good values from joint families; replacement keeps the same से ... मिलते हैं pattern and family theme without the sermon.

target: बच्चों ने त्योहार पर सबको मिठाई बाँटी।
english: The children handed out sweets to everyone at the festival.
reason: Crime-report register with literary vocabulary (ठगों, राहगीरों) in a node about culture; replacement keeps the ergative ने + को frame with a festival scene.

target: इस काम से जुड़े सारे कागज़ मैंने तैयार कर लिए हैं।
english: I have got all the papers related to this work ready.
reason: Flat officialese with none of the compound-verb or ergative usage this node teaches; replacement adds कर लिए + मैंने while keeping the से जुड़े pattern.
